## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Japanese Tang-pilgrim importation catalog** by **Engyō** 圓行 (Japanese **Engyō**, **799–852**), one of the *nittō hakke*. Engyō traveled to Tang in **838** (returning **839**) in the same Japanese embassy as **Jōgyō** 常曉 ([KR6s0109](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0109)) and **Ennin** 圓仁. His catalog documents the texts and ritual materials he brought back, with particular emphasis on **Esoteric** materials. Preserved at T55 no. 2164.

**Abstract**

Authorship and date: by **Engyō** 圓行 (Japanese, **799–852**), produced upon his **839** return to Japan. *notBefore* = **839**, *notAfter* = **839**. Catalog dynasty 日本.

The work is one of the **eight foundational Heian-era Tang-importation catalogs**, supplementing the larger and more consequential Saichō, Kūkai, and Ennin importations with additional Esoteric materials.
